_comment: Every credential the estate depends on, its home (never its value), and its expiry. check-secrets-expiry.mjs reads this and opens an issue N days before any dated one lapses. Live-checkable entries (GitHub tokens, JWT keys) are re-verified against reality on every run; the file's date is the fallback and the record. Add a row whenever a new credential is introduced or rotated. NEVER put a secret value here - this file is public on main.

secrets.name: GH_PAT
secrets.where: repo secret (all 7 repos); mirrors the gh CLI keyring token on the Mac
secrets.note: Fallback only. Every workflow mints a GitHub App installation token FIRST (app-token || GH_PAT || GITHUB_TOKEN), and App tokens never expire. When this lapses, automation is unaffected; only a human running gh/git-over-HTTPS on the Mac is, and that is fixed with `gh auth login`.

secrets.name: AUTOPILOT_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.where: repo secret (all 7 repos), GitHub App Smarter-Poker-Autopilot id 4680372
secrets.note: The merge + publish credential. A GitHub App PEM does not expire; installation tokens are minted per run and last an hour. Losing the App (deleting it, or revoking the install) stops all auto-merge and publish - but that is a deletion, not an expiry, so there is no date to watch.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.where: repo secret (CI) + Hetzner server/.env + Supabase dashboard
secrets.note: New sb_secret_ format - non-expiring (verified 2026-09-01). If it is ever rotated back to a legacy eyJ JWT, live_check decodes its exp and this row's date must be set.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY / VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.where: repo secret + bundled into the client build
secrets.note: New sb_publishable_ format - non-expiring. Public by design.

secrets.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
secrets.note: VERIFY: Vercel account tokens can be created with or without expiry. Check https://vercel.com/account/tokens and set the date here, or confirm no-expiry. Its loss would break the (rarely used) Vercel API paths, not the git-integration deploys.

secrets.name: HETZNER_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY / hetzner_engine_key
secrets.note: SSH keys do not expire. Loss = no engine deploys; recovery is adding a new public key to the box (which needs existing access - so keep the Mac copy safe, DR runbook covers rotation).

secrets.name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
secrets.note: VERIFY: Sentry auth tokens can expire. Loss only breaks sourcemap upload (stack traces come back minified), never a deploy. Check Sentry org settings and set the date.

secrets.name: CRON_SECRET
secrets.where: repo secret + Hetzner Open Claw VM + Vercel env
secrets.note: Shared bearer for every scheduled job. Does not expire, but a ROTATION that misses one host silently 401s the whole cron fleet (this happened 2026-08-31). Not an expiry item; listed so the rotation footgun is on record. cron-fleet liveness is watched by check-cron-fleet-alive.mjs.

secrets.name: TURN_STATIC_AUTH_SECRET
secrets.note: Static secret, non-expiring. In the encrypted DR backup.
